title: The Horrors Within
description: Do not trust what you see.
body:
![Scary monster behind a tree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0f3055ee1b014fe48d5b3d098a4bc0aef900975.jpeg)

*The Horrors Within* is an immersive, psychological horror modpack designed to transform your familiar Minecraft world into a terrifying, paranoia-inducing nightmare. If you feel like vanilla survival has gotten too easy or safe, this pack will make you dread the setting sun. Built around unpredictable entities, stalking monsters, and sensory overhauls, you will quickly realize that you are no longer alone in this world.

This pack carefully curates a selection of the most terrifying modern horror mods, ambient sound physics, and abandoned world generation to completely overhaul the feel of the game.

<small>(Note: I highly recommend playing with the included Shaders enabled to get the VHS lighting and atmosphere exactly as intended!)</small>

_BE CAREFUL_

**DO NOT TRUST WHAT YOU SEE...**
